args.title: venice: deterministic read-only workflow schedule audit v1
args.body:
## What
Adds a deterministic, read-only inventory of the configured SEC/options workflow triggers and source hashes for checklist-engine, per docs/VENICE_WORKFLOW_AUDIT_TRIAL_V1.md.

## Files
- agent/workflow_schedule_audit.py (audit generator, read-only)
- agent/workflow_audit_requirements.txt
- agent/requests/workflow-schedule-audit.json
- agent/fixtures/workflow_schedule_audit/**
- tests/test_workflow_schedule_audit.py
- docs/VENICE_WORKFLOW_SCHEDULE_AUDIT_V1.md
- .github/workflows/venice-workflow-schedule-audit.yml (push-triggered, branch-filtered, minimal permissions)

## Proof
- Green run on this exact head: https://github.com/SRoyaltyy/checklist-engine/actions/runs/42507126338 (sha a5deb2c4ba100e83609556312a92bb4f6d8030ea, conclusion success)
- Artifact workflow-schedule-audit-42507126338 sha256:4a4bb7cad513e73257beebce2eaa1ea7a354aea678652cda5c857fd4cc1774be
- Supersedes the earlier red run 42506461802 on ff9f393.

## Scope
Read-only. No collector changes, no production pipeline workflow changes. Publication/merge is gated on the operator flag (currently disabled).
